julia_support: Heads-up — Bluepine BYOK onboarding hitting a blocker. They get `WrapKeyOperation: AccessDenied` when our service principal tries to wrap DEKs in their Azure Key Vault in a different subscription. They also want vault audit events forwarded to our pipeline. Attaching their error snippet.
sam_csm: here's the exact error from Bluepine: `Error: Operation 'wrapKey' failed with status '403' - Access denied for principal 12ab34cd-...` They said vault-level RBAC was 'Owner' on their side for a user but not for our SP.
alex_security: ok — likely RBAC/Key Vault access policy mismatch. For cross-subscription access our SP needs either a Key Vault access policy (wrapKey/unwrapKey/get) or the Azure RBAC role that grants crypto ops on the vault resource. Can you confirm whether they used access policies or Azure RBAC on the vault?
maria_eng: also put a note on audit forwarding — need Diagnostic Settings on the vault to send `AuditEvent` to Event Hub or Log Analytics. Without that we won't see wrap/unwrap attempts.
julia_support: they said they used "Access policies" and didn't set any RBAC role assignments. They expect us to be able to use the SP object id.
alex_security: if they're using access policies, run this to add permissions for the SP (requires Owner on the vault subscription):
```
az keyvault set-policy --name <vault-name> --object-id <service-principal-object-id> --key-permissions wrapKey unwrapKey get
```
If they prefer Azure RBAC, assign the built-in role `Key Vault Crypto User` on the vault resource:
```
az role assignment create --assignee <sp-id> --role "Key Vault Crypto User" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault-name>
```
tim_sre: on our ingestion side I don't see events for that vault in the last 24h. Ask them to enable Diagnostic Settings -> send to Event Hub / partner namespace we gave them. Example CLI to enable:
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name send-audit --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault> --nsg --event-hub <eh-namespace-id> --logs '[{"category":"AuditEvent","enabled":true}]'
```
joe_devex: noted — docs gap: we don't have a short example that covers cross-subscription SP + access-policy fallback. I'll add a step-by-step: create SP, grant access policy, confirm wrap/unwrap, enable diag settings. Julia, can you paste the minimal repro (SP id + vault resource id) into the ticket?
maria_eng: rotation note — recommend staged rotation: 1) create a new key version (or a new key), 2) update our wrapping config to use new key for new DEKs, 3) keep old key version enabled for unwrap of existing ciphertext until all objects rotated, 4) then disable / schedule purge after retention window. CLI to create new key version:
```
az keyvault key create --vault-name <vault> -n <key-name> -p '{"kty":"RSA","key_ops":["wrapKey","unwrapKey","encrypt","decrypt"]}'
```
alex_security: small gotcha — Azure Key Vault has two surface areas: vault-level access policies and Azure RBAC. If they later switch to RBAC, ensure the SP is assigned `Key Vault Crypto User` (not Contributor) so permissions are least-privilege.
support_bot: :ticket: created support ticket BP-3421 and linked to oncall queue
ops-bot: added to sec-oncall rotation for investigation :rotating_light:
sam_csm: thanks — i'll get the SP object id and the subscription id from Bluepine and drop here. quick Q: will rotating the KEK break our prefix cache/DEK reuse in Redwood inference flows?
maria_eng: as long as wrap/unwrap still works for old ciphertext we are fine. Best practice: keep the previous key available for unwrap until you rotate ciphertext in place or rewrap DEKs. Avoid deleting old key versions immediately. :white_check_mark:
julia_support: perfect. i'll follow up with them and add the CLI snippets to BP-3421. cc @joe_devex to add the walkthrough to docs.
joe_devex: will draft the doc today and attach a quick checklist + sample `az` commands and a note about diagnostic categories.
alex_security: final: also remind them to grant `Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments/write` to whoever does the role assignment or pre-create and send us the role assignment proof. Otherwise they hit subtle RBAC permission errors.
julia_support: thanks everyone — i'll update thread when Bluepine sends the IDs.
